question: Which of the following leaders is associated with the concept of ‘Drain of Wealth’ theory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji is known as the **Grand Old Man of India** and was a key figure in Indian nationalism.
 
• He introduced the **'Drain of Wealth' theory**, which explained how the British colonial rule was draining economic resources from India.
 
• The theory was first articulated in his book **"Poverty and Un-British Rule in India."**
 
• Naoroji argued that British policies led to a systematic transfer of India's wealth to Britain, causing widespread poverty in India.
 
• He highlighted factors like excessive land revenue, high taxation, and the export of raw materials without adequate compensation to India as contributors to the economic drain.
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji was also the first Indian to be elected to the British Parliament and used his position to advocate for Indian interests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose:**

 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement and the founder of the Indian National Army (INA).
 
• He is famous for his slogan **"Give me blood, and I will give you freedom."**
 
• Although he played a critical role in the freedom struggle.
 
 
 
• **MG Ranade:**
 
 
• Mahadev Govind Ranade was a noted social reformer and economist during the British rule.
 
• He emphasized industrialization and modern education as solutions for India’s economic challenges.
 
• While his contributions to Indian economics are significant.
 
 
 
• **C Rajagopalachari:**
 
 
• C Rajagopalachari, also known as Rajaji, was an Indian politician, freedom fighter, and the last Governor-General of India.
 
• He was known for his administrative skills and writings.
